description: Record the system owner's decision on a reviewed access request: granted, denied, or returned to the requester with a note. Granting re-runs the hard rules in code (unknown role, segregation-of-duties conflict, role already held, duplicate open request, duration over the limit) and refuses when any fails, needs a note when the review recommended escalate, and writes the entitlement with the request's end date as its expiry. Returning needs a note and puts the request back to the requester for a resubmission. Every decision appends an event. Fired only from the operator-confirmed Grant / Return / Deny action via the direct-invoke lane; not listed in any agent's tools, so the model cannot call it.

request_id.description: The request to decide, e.g. req_tom_github_developer.

note.description: The system owner's note, recorded with the decision. Required for returned, and for granted when the review recommended escalate.
